result.summary: Found 1 issue: a string localization or content display error in the 'popular' section header.

issues.description: The section header for the popular restaurants list is displayed as a technical string 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of the intended human-readable text.
issues.suggestion: Update the app localization files or backend content management system to correctly map the key 'home_feed.popular_title' to the appropriate localized label (e.g., 'Popular in Tallinn').
